subject: Post-call: FinX security & pilot onboarding — evidence, retention, next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@finxbank.com>, Security Team <security@finxbank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-25T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap — FinX security & pilot onboarding checklist

Aaron / FinX security team,

Thanks again for the discussion today — good to meet everyone.  Quick recap of the pain points you called out, the outcomes you want, and the proposed next steps so we have alignment before we put the legal/procurement track in motion.

Pain points noted:
- SOC 2: FinX requires a current SOC 2 Type II attestation or equivalent evidence for any vendor with access to production data.
- Audit logs & retention: 7-year immutable audit logs for user and admin activity; retention policy must be configurable per-tenant.
- Data residency & export controls: core production data must remain in US regions for now.
- DPA / contractual terms: FinX has a mandatory DPA and vendor data handling clauses; procurement will need a draft to start redlines.
- Pen test evidence: need a summary of recent penetration tests and a scope that shows regular 3rd-party assessments.
- Key management: KMS integration and support for HSM-backed keys for encryption in transit and at rest.

Goals we discussed:
1) Pilot: sandbox + test data within 3 weeks; production pilot (limited traffic) targeted by end of Q1.
2) Security gating: Provide artifacts for security review to satisfy FinX internal controls within 10 business days.
3) Contract: sign DPA and pilot SOW to get procurement moving.

What Redwood will deliver (proposed):
- SOC 2 summary and scope + PDF attestation (attached: redwood_soc2_summary_2026-12.pdf).
- Audit-log retention matrix showing configurable retention windows & export formats (attached: audit-log-retention-matrix.xlsx).
- Pen-test scope and last-test summary (attached stub: pen-test-scope-stub.txt); full 3rd-party report can be provided under an NDA if needed.
- Draft DPA for FinX review (attached: DPA_Draft_Redwood_FinX.docx).
- KMS integration doc & steps for customer-managed keys (inline summary below).

Immediate asks for FinX (to keep pilot timeline):
- Confirm who will be the FinX security PoC (name + email) for artifact intake.
- Confirm acceptance criteria for the pilot (example: throughput, latency SLOs, no production PII in sandbox).
- Confirm whether FinX legal prefers DocuSign or counterparty markup for the DPA.

Proposed next steps / owners / target dates:
- Chloe: Deliver artifacts above to Security Team and PO (today) — ACTION: deliver attachments (done).
- FinX Security PoC: Review artifacts and list any gaps — ACTION: feedback within 7 business days.
- David Kim (Redwood): Prepare a minimal pilot SOW and deployment checklist — ACTION: draft to FinX by 2027-01-29.
- Legal teams: Begin DPA redlines in parallel — ACTION: FinX confirm preferred signing flow by 2027-01-27.

If that matches what you heard, I’ll get the artifacts uploaded to the shared drive and create a HubSpot Milestone for the pilot.

Thanks,

Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Aaron Li <aaron.li@finxbank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@finxbank.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-26T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — FinX security & pilot onboarding checklist

Chloe,

Appreciate the quick summary and attachments — that was fast. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with procurement/security: 

1) SOC 2: we can accept a SOC 2 Type II report from 2026; however, we need evidence of remediation items if any were outstanding at the time of the report. Can you provide a remediation summary?

2) Audit logs: 7-year retention is a hard requirement for some data classes. We need to see the retention enforcement model (immutable storage, chain of custody). The matrix is a good start — please add a column that maps each log type to immutability and export procedures.

3) Pen test: FinX requires a 3rd-party pen-test report that covers our threat model (API-level auth bypass, tenant isolation, key management). If full report requires NDA, we’ll get that signed — procurement prefers staging evidence first (summary + remediation timeline).

4) DPA: procurement will use DocuSign. We’ll want to redline Section 7 (data deletion/return) and Section 11 (subprocessors).

5) KMS/HSM: Confirm if Redwood supports customer-managed keys (we saw note in the doc) and whether HSM-backed keys are enforced for production.

We will designate a security PoC — I’ll loop them in on the next message. Also: can you confirm the exact artifacts we will receive within the next 7 business days so we can mark the HubSpot milestone?

Thanks,
Aaron Li
Director, Vendor Security | FinX Bank
aaron.li@finxbank.com
